name: fix_submit_exercise_attempt_ambiguous_columns
query: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_exercise_attempt(p_attempt_id uuid, p_answers jsonb) RETURNS TABLE(attempt_id uuid, status text, score numeric, percentage numeric, total_questions integer, correct_answers integer, incorrect_answers integer, submitted_at timestamptz, correction_markdown text) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ DECLARE v_exercise_id uuid; v_auto_total integer; v_correct integer; v_total integer; v_percentage numeric; v_status text; BEGIN IF jsonb_typeof(p_answers) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Les réponses doivent être fournies sous la forme d’un objet.'; END IF; SELECT a.exercise_id INTO v_exercise_id FROM public.exercise_attempts AS a WHERE a.id = p_attempt_id AND a.user_id = auth.uid() AND a.status = 'in_progress'; IF v_exercise_id IS NULL OR NOT public.can_access_exercise_for_current_student(v_exercise_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cette tentative ne peut pas être soumise.'; END IF; SELECT count(*)::integer, count(*) FILTER (WHERE q.question_type IN ('single_choice','multiple_choice','true_false'))::integer, count(*) FILTER (WHERE q.question_type IN ('single_choice','multiple_choice','true_false') AND CASE WHEN q.question_type = 'multiple_choice' THEN NOT EXISTS ((SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(q.correct_answers) EXCEPT SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(p_answers -> q.id::text,'[]'::jsonb))) UNION ALL (SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(p_answers -> q.id::text,'[]'::jsonb)) EXCEPT SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(q.correct_answers))) ELSE q.correct_answers = COALESCE(p_answers -> q.id::text,'[]'::jsonb) END)::integer INTO v_total, v_auto_total, v_correct FROM public.exercise_questions AS q WHERE q.exercise_id = v_exercise_id; v_percentage := CASE WHEN v_auto_total > 0 THEN round((v_correct::numeric / v_auto_total::numeric) * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END; v_status := CASE WHEN v_auto_total = v_total THEN 'submitted' ELSE 'review_required' END; UPDATE public.exercise_attempts AS a SET answers = p_answers, status = v_status, score = CASE WHEN v_auto_total > 0 THEN v_correct ELSE NULL END, percentage = v_percentage, total_questions = v_total, correct_answers = v_correct, incorrect_answers = GREATEST(v_auto_total - v_correct, 0), submitted_at = now(), duration_seconds = GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - a.started_at))::integer) WHERE a.id = p_attempt_id; RETURN QUERY SELECT a.id, a.status, a.score, a.percentage, a.total_questions, a.correct_answers, a.incorrect_answers, a.submitted_at, e.correction_markdown FROM public.exercise_attempts AS a JOIN public.exercises AS e ON e.id = a.exercise_id WHERE a.id = p_attempt_id; END; $$; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.submit_exercise_attempt(uuid,jsonb) FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.submit_exercise_attempt(uuid,jsonb) FROM anon; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.submit_exercise_attempt(uuid,jsonb) TO authenticated;
